meta.title: NOW — Next One Word | RSVP reader, one word at a time
meta.description: Free RSVP reader. Paste a text and read one word at a time, at a fixed point.
meta.readTitle: NOW — RSVP reader: paste text and read one word at a time
meta.readDescription: Paste a text in NOW and read one word at a time. Set the pace, pause with Space.

hero.body: NOW flashes a long text as a single word on a fixed point, so your eyes stop scanning the page. Paste something, set a pace, press Now.

steps.title: Paste
steps.body: Drop in an article, chapter, or notes. Nothing is uploaded. It stays in this browser.

steps.title: Set the pace
steps.body: Pick a number from 100 to 700. Longer words and punctuation get a little more time.

steps.title: Now
steps.body: Each word lands on the same point. Tap or Space pauses. Esc brings you back to the text.

faq.a: NOW (Next One Word) is a free RSVP reader: it shows one word at a time on a fixed point so you can move through long text faster.
Rapid Serial Visual Presentation. Words appear one after another in the same place, so your eyes do not scan across a line.
No. There is no sign-up. Text, speed, and history stay only in this browser.
Languages that use spaces between words — Portuguese, English, Spanish, French, and similar. Chinese, Japanese, and Korean are out of scope.
It uses the same one-word idea, with an ORP pivot in the theme color. There is no red letter and no Spritz account.

about.title: NOW
about.p1: A simple reader that shows one word at a time so you can move through long text faster, with less eye travel across the page.
about.p2: Paste something you want to read, set a speed, press <now>Now</now>. Each word lands on a fixed point; longer words and punctuation get a little more time.
